2. Diagnostic plots: residuals vs fitted, QQ‐plot of random effects, overdispersion assessment.
3. Post‐hoc contrast table of year slopes between protection statuses (with p‐values adjusted for multiple comparisons).

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import statsmodels.api as sm
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# 1. Load and clean data
df = pd.read_csv('reef.csv')
df = df.dropna(subset=['size', 'quantity', 'id_reef', 'year', 'protection_status'])
df = df[df['quantity'] >= 0]

# 2. Mark small-bodied individuals (<10 cm)
df['small_count'] = df.apply(lambda r: r['quantity'] if r['size'] < 10 else 0, axis=1)

# 3. Aggregate counts by reef-year-status
grp = df.groupby(['id_reef', 'year', 'protection_status'])
agg = grp.agg(
    total_count=('quantity', 'sum'),
    small_count=('small_count', 'sum')
).reset_index()
agg = agg[agg['total_count'] > 0]
agg['prop_small'] = agg['small_count'] / agg['total_count']

# 4. Fit GEE binomial model (clustered by reef) as an approximation to GLMM
model = smf.gee(
    'prop_small ~ year * C(protection_status, Treatment(reference="sin proteccion"))',
    groups='id_reef', data=agg,
    family=sm.families.Binomial(),
    weights=agg['total_count']
)
res = model.fit()

# 5. Model summary and overdispersion
def print_line(): print('-'*80)
print_line()
print("GEE Binomial Model Summary:")
print(res.summary())
# Overdispersion: Pearson chi2 / df_resid
pearson_chi2 = sum(res.resid_pearson**2)
df_resid = res.df_resid
dispersion = pearson_chi2 / df_resid
print(f"\nOverdispersion ratio (Pearson chi2/df): {dispersion:.2f}")

# 6. Extract annual log-odds slopes and ORs by protection status
year_coef = res.params['year']
slopes = {'sin proteccion': year_coef}
for status in ['area protegida', 'cabo pulmo', 'refugio pesquero']:
    term = f'year:C(protection_status, Treatment(reference="sin proteccion"))[T.{status}]'
    slopes[status] = year_coef + res.params.get(term, 0.0)
or_slopes = {k: np.exp(v) for k, v in slopes.items()}

print_line()
print("Annual Slopes (log-odds) and Odds Ratios by Protection Status:")
for st in slopes:
    print(f"  {st}: log-odds={slopes[st]:.4f}, OR={or_slopes[st]:.4f}")

# 7. Post-hoc tests for slope differences vs unprotected
print_line()
print("Post-hoc Slope Differences vs 'sin proteccion':")
for status in ['area protegida','cabo pulmo','refugio pesquero']:
    term = f'year:C(protection_status, Treatment(reference="sin proteccion"))[T.{status}]'
    if term in res.params.index:
        test = res.t_test(f"{term} = 0")
        pval = float(test.pvalue)
        print(f"  {status} vs sin proteccion: p = {pval:.4f}")

# 8. Diagnostic: residuals vs fitted
plt.figure(figsize=(6,4))
plt.scatter(res.fittedvalues, res.resid_pearson, alpha=0.4)
plt.axhline(0, color='gray', linestyle='--')
plt.xlabel('Fitted values')
plt.ylabel('Pearson residuals')
plt.title('Residuals vs Fitted')
plt.show()

# 9. Time-series plot with predictions
sns.set(style="whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
# observed
sns.scatterplot(data=agg, x='year', y='prop_small', hue='protection_status', alpha=0.3)
# predicted curves
years = np.arange(agg['year'].min(), agg['year'].max()+1)
preds = []
for st in agg['protection_status'].cat.categories if hasattr(agg['protection_status'], 'cat') else agg['protection_status'].unique():
    dfp = pd.DataFrame({'year': years, 'protection_status': st})
    dfp['pred'] = res.predict(dfp)
    preds.append(dfp)
preds = pd.concat(preds)
sns.lineplot(data=preds, x='year', y='pred', hue='protection_status', linewidth=2.5)
plt.title('Proportion of Small-bodied Fish Over Time')
plt.ylabel('Proportion Small (<10 cm)')
plt.xlabel('Year')
plt.legend(title='Protection Status')
plt.show()

# 10. Interpretation
print_line()
print("Interpretation of trends:")
for st in slopes:
    trend = 'increasing' if slopes[st] > 0 else 'decreasing'
    print(f" - {st}: OR per year = {or_slopes[st]:.3f}, indicating {trend} odds of small-bodied fish over time.")
print_line()

{"code":"import pandas as pd
import statsmodels.api as sm
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# 1. Load and clean data
df = pd.read_csv('reef.csv')
df = df.dropna(subset=['size', 'quantity', 'id_reef', 'year', 'protection_status'])
df = df[df['quantity'] >= 0]

# 2. Assign size classes
# Only small (<10 cm) needed for counts

df['is_small'] = (df['size'] < 10).astype(int)

# 3. Aggregate per reef-year-status
agg = df.groupby(['id_reef', 'year', 'protection_status']).agg(
    total_count=('quantity', 'sum'),
    small_count=('is_small', lambda x: (x * df.loc[x.index, 'quantity']).sum())
).reset_index()
# Ensure small_count non-null
agg['small_count'] = agg['small_count'].fillna(0).astype(int)

# Drop zero-total rows to avoid division errors
agg = agg[agg['total_count'] > 0]
# Fraction for GEE
agg['prop_small'] = agg['small_count'] / agg['total_count']

# 4. Fit marginal model (GEE) with binomial family and clustering by reef
model = smf.gee(
    'prop_small ~ year * C(protection_status, Treatment(reference="sin proteccion"))',
    groups='id_reef', data=agg,
    family=sm.families.Binomial(),
    weights=agg['total_count']
)
res = model.fit()

# 5. Output model summary
print("\nGEE Binomial model summary:")
print(res.summary())

# 6. Extract slopes (log-odds change per year) by status
coef = res.params
year_coef = coef['year']
slopes = {'sin proteccion': year_coef}
for status in ['area protegida', 'cabo pulmo', 'refugio pesquero']:
    key = f'year:C(protection_status, Treatment(reference="sin proteccion"))[T.{status}]'
    slopes[status] = year_coef + coef.get(key, 0)

# Convert to odds ratio per year
or_slopes = {k: (pd.np.exp(v)) for k, v in slopes.items()}
print("\nAnnual slope (log-odds) and OR of small-bodied proportion by protection status:")
for status in slopes:
    print(f"  {status}: log-odds slope={slopes[status]:.4f}, OR={or_slopes[status]:.4f}")

# 7. Post-hoc tests: test interaction coefficients vs zero
print("\nTests of slope differences from unprotected (sin proteccion):")
for status in ['area protegida', 'cabo pulmo', 'refugio pesquero']:
    term = f'year:C(protection_status, Treatment(reference="sin proteccion"))[T.{status}]'
    if term in coef.index:
        test = res.t_test(f"{term} = 0")
        pval = test.pvalue
        print(f"  Difference in slope ({status} vs sin proteccion): p = {pval[0][0]:.4f}")

# 8. Plot observed and model-predicted proportions
sns.set(style="whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
# Scatter observed
sns.scatterplot(
    data=agg, x='year', y='prop_small', hue='protection_status',
    alpha=0.3, legend='brief'
)
# Prepare prediction grid
years = pd.DataFrame({'year': range(int(agg['year'].min()), int(agg['year'].max())+1)})
preds = []
for status in agg['protection_status'].unique():
    df_pred = years.copy()
    df_pred['protection_status'] = status
    df_pred['prop_small'] = res.predict(df_pred)
    preds.append(df_pred)
preds = pd.concat(preds)
# Plot predicted lines
sns.lineplot(
    data=preds, x='year', y='prop_small', hue='protection_status',
    linewidth=2.5
)
plt.title('Observed and Model-Predicted Proportion of Small-bodied Fish Over Time')
plt.ylabel('Proportion Small (<10 cm)')
plt.xlabel('Year')
plt.legend(title='Protection Status')
plt.show()

# 9. Interpretation
print("\nInterpretation:")
for status in slopes:
    trend = 'increasing' if slopes[status] > 0 else 'decreasing'
    print(f" - {status}: OR={or_slopes[status]:.3f}, indicating {trend} odds of small-bodied individuals over time.")
"}

import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# 1. Load and clean data
df = pd.read_csv('reef.csv')
df = df.dropna(subset=['size', 'quantity', 'id_reef', 'year', 'protection_status'])
df = df[df['quantity'] >= 0]

# 2. Mark small-bodied individuals (<10 cm)
df['small_count'] = df.apply(lambda r: r['quantity'] if r['size'] < 10 else 0, axis=1)

# 3. Aggregate counts by reef-year-status
grp = df.groupby(['id_reef', 'year', 'protection_status'])
agg = grp.agg(
    total_count=('quantity', 'sum'),
    small_count=('small_count', 'sum')
).reset_index()
agg = agg[agg['total_count'] > 0]
agg['prop_small'] = agg['small_count'] / agg['total_count']

# 4. Fit GEE binomial model (clustered by reef) as an approximation to GLMM
model = smf.gee(
    'prop_small ~ year * C(protection_status, Treatment(reference="sin proteccion"))',
    groups='id_reef', data=agg,
    family=sm.families.Binomial(),
    weights=agg['total_count']
)
res = model.fit()

# 5. Model summary and overdispersion
def print_line(): print('-'*80)
print_line()
print("GEE Binomial Model Summary:")
print(res.summary())
# Overdispersion: Pearson chi2 / df_resid
pearson_chi2 = sum(res.resid_pearson**2)
df_resid = res.df_resid
dispersion = pearson_chi2 / df_resid
print(f"\nOverdispersion ratio (Pearson chi2/df): {dispersion:.2f}")

# 6. Extract annual log-odds slopes and ORs by protection status
year_coef = res.params['year']
slopes = {'sin proteccion': year_coef}
for status in ['area protegida', 'cabo pulmo', 'refugio pesquero']:
    term = f'year:C(protection_status, Treatment(reference="sin proteccion"))[T.{status}]'
    slopes[status] = year_coef + res.params.get(term, 0.0)
or_slopes = {k: np.exp(v) for k, v in slopes.items()}

print_line()
print("Annual Slopes (log-odds) and Odds Ratios by Protection Status:")
for st in slopes:
    print(f"  {st}: log-odds={slopes[st]:.4f}, OR={or_slopes[st]:.4f}")

# 7. Post-hoc tests for slope differences vs unprotected
print_line()
print("Post-hoc Slope Differences vs 'sin proteccion':")
for status in ['area protegida','cabo pulmo','refugio pesquero']:
    term = f'year:C(protection_status, Treatment(reference="sin proteccion"))[T.{status}]'
    if term in res.params.index:
        test = res.t_test(f"{term} = 0")
        pval = float(test.pvalue)
        print(f"  {status} vs sin proteccion: p = {pval:.4f}")

# 8. Diagnostic: residuals vs fitted
plt.figure(figsize=(6,4))
plt.scatter(res.fittedvalues, res.resid_pearson, alpha=0.4)
plt.axhline(0, color='gray', linestyle='--')
plt.xlabel('Fitted values')
plt.ylabel('Pearson residuals')
plt.title('Residuals vs Fitted')
plt.show()

# 9. Time-series plot with predictions
sns.set(style="whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
# observed
sns.scatterplot(data=agg, x='year', y='prop_small', hue='protection_status', alpha=0.3)
# predicted curves
years = np.arange(agg['year'].min(), agg['year'].max()+1)
preds = []
for st in agg['protection_status'].cat.categories if hasattr(agg['protection_status'], 'cat') else agg['protection_status'].unique():
    dfp = pd.DataFrame({'year': years, 'protection_status': st})
    dfp['pred'] = res.predict(dfp)
    preds.append(dfp)
preds = pd.concat(preds)
sns.lineplot(data=preds, x='year', y='pred', hue='protection_status', linewidth=2.5)
plt.title('Proportion of Small-bodied Fish Over Time')
plt.ylabel('Proportion Small (<10 cm)')
plt.xlabel('Year')
plt.legend(title='Protection Status')
plt.show()

# 10. Interpretation
print_line()
print("Interpretation of trends:")
for st in slopes:
    trend = 'increasing' if slopes[st] > 0 else 'decreasing'
    print(f" - {st}: OR per year = {or_slopes[st]:.3f}, indicating {trend} odds of small-bodied fish over time.")
print_line()"}
